faq.q: Is the price on each sold card the price the home sold for?
faq.a: The page does not say. Each card shows a price alongside Status: Sold and the MLS® number, with no label stating whether it is the sold price or the final list price, and no sold date — ask Jared for the sold price and completion details on any specific property.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Sold Properties?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Sold Properties is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
